description: Launch planning with many tasks: most with an explicit owner, two unowned. Invented people and facts.
lines: We have a lot to split up before the launch, so let's go person by person.
I'll write the launch blog post and have a draft by Thursday.
I'll update the pricing page with the new student tier.
I can record the product walkthrough video on Monday.
I'll email the twenty beta customers to tell them the launch date.
Sam, please also check the checkout works in euros.
Sure, I'll test euro checkout tomorrow.
Lena, can you book the photographer for the team photo?
Someone needs to renew the domain certificate before it expires next week.
And somebody should update the press kit, the logo in it is old.
Right, let's figure out who takes those two later. Marcus, you also own the status page, yes?
Yes, I'll set up the status page before launch.
